svg.title: Accuracy by pipeline and tier
svg.desc: Lineage-equal tie-aware AUPRC with 95% CIs on training, validation and test lineages. P1 gains about 0.05 over generic Human1 on every tier, but sits far below the gene prior and below the expression tie-break.
